'''2001 Atlanta DPC warm-up tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Atlanta, Georgia on 27 July 2001. [[Andy McClure]] won it. It is known from Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2743">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-maybe-i-dont-suck-at-this-game-afteralld2743/ maybe-i-dont-suck-at-this-game-afterall], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 30 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-maybe-i-dont-suck-at-this-game-afteralld2743/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Atlanta DPC]].

* '''Date:''' 27 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy McClure]]
